[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Lajar Weqill''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who accepted [[Jameson]] offer to hunt [[draagax]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Relkass]]. Weqill needed the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to buy passage off the planet.<ref name="COG" />
